from data
where device_uuid = '00000003-0001-0005-0000-000000000001' AND $__timeFilter("timestamp")

SELECT 
  SUM(phv_phsc_mag) / ((COUNT(phv_phsc_mag) * 3600.0) / (($__to - $__from) / 1000.0))
FROM 
  data
WHERE 
  timestamp >= $__timeFrom() and timestamp <= $__timeTo() and device_uuid = '00000001-0006-0020-0000-000000000001';
